---
title: "Overall survival — estimand"
subtitle: "182-day RMST, survival, and risk contrasts"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(rstanarm)
library(mice)
library(ggdist)
library(here)
library(arrow)
library(yaml)
library(tidyverse)
source(here("R", "plot-style.R"))

config <- read_yaml(here("config", "analysis.yml"))
source(here("R", "survival.R"))
source(here("R", "posterior.R"))

results_dir <- here("analysis", "02-overall-survival", "01-main", "results")
figure_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "figures")
dir.create(figure_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

indices <- seq_len(config$imputation$m_main)
horizon_days <- config$analysis$horizon_days
n_draws <- config$posterior_draws$main
```

## Standardized survival curves

```{r}
#| label: standardized-survival-curves
#| include: false

pooled_curves <- indices |>
  map(function(index) {
    model <- readRDS(
      file.path(results_dir, "models", sprintf("model-%02d.rds", index))
    )
    standardization_data <- readRDS(
      file.path(
        results_dir,
        "imputations",
        sprintf("imputation-%02d.rds", index)
      )
    ) |>
      complete(1) |>
      mutate(mgps = factor(mgps, levels = 0:2))

    # Same seed for both groups, so each draw pairs ctDNA and usual-care curves.
    posterior_standardized_survival_draws(
      model,
      standardization_data,
      horizon = horizon_days,
      n_points = 200L,
      n_draws = n_draws,
      seed = config$seeds$survival + (index - 1) * 1000
    ) |>
      mutate(tx = as.integer(tx), imputation = index)
  }) |>
  list_rbind()
```

## RMST and 182-day survival contrasts

```{r}
#| label: rmst-and-risk-draws
#| include: false

pooled_rmst <- pooled_curves |>
  compute_rmst_draws(
    horizon = horizon_days,
    group_cols = c("tx", "imputation")
  ) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = tx, values_from = rmst, names_prefix = "rmst_") |>
  arrange(imputation, draw) |>
  mutate(rmst_diff = rmst_1 - rmst_0)

pooled_risks <- pooled_curves |>
  survival_risk_draws(horizon = horizon_days, treatment_col = "tx") |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = tx,
    values_from = survival,
    names_prefix = "survival_"
  ) |>
  arrange(imputation, draw) |>
  mutate(
    risk_difference = survival_1 - survival_0,
    risk_ratio = survival_1 / survival_0
  )

stopifnot(
  "Treatment and control draws could not be matched." =
    nrow(pooled_rmst) == length(indices) * n_draws &&
    nrow(pooled_risks) == length(indices) * n_draws &&
    !anyNA(pooled_rmst) &&
    !anyNA(pooled_risks)
)
```

```{r}
#| label: summarize-estimands
#| include: false

rmst_summary <- summarize_posterior_draws(pooled_rmst$rmst_diff) |>
  mutate(
    probability_benefit = posterior_probability(pooled_rmst$rmst_diff),
    # q columns above are type-8 quantiles; the ci_* bounds are type-7.
    ci_66_low = quantile(pooled_rmst$rmst_diff, 0.17, names = FALSE),
    ci_66_high = quantile(pooled_rmst$rmst_diff, 0.83, names = FALSE),
    ci_95_low = quantile(pooled_rmst$rmst_diff, 0.025, names = FALSE),
    ci_95_high = quantile(pooled_rmst$rmst_diff, 0.975, names = FALSE),
    rope_low = -7,
    rope_high = 7,
    rope_66_contains = ci_66_low >= rope_low & ci_66_high <= rope_high,
    horizon_days = horizon_days
  )

risk_summary <- bind_rows(
  summarize_posterior_draws(pooled_risks$risk_difference),
  summarize_posterior_draws(
    pooled_risks$risk_ratio[is.finite(pooled_risks$risk_ratio)]
  )
) |>
  transmute(
    measure = c("survival_risk_difference", "survival_risk_ratio"),
    mean,
    median,
    q025 = `q 2.5`,
    q975 = `q97.5`,
    horizon_days = horizon_days
  )

max_curve_day <- max(pooled_curves$time, na.rm = TRUE)
follow_up_sufficiency <- tibble(
  horizon_days = c(182L, 365L),
  sufficient = c(max_curve_day >= 182, max_curve_day >= 365),
  reason = c(
    if (max_curve_day >= 182) {
      "Primary OS curves cover 182 days."
    } else {
      "Primary OS curves do not cover 182 days."
    },
    if (max_curve_day >= 365) {
      "OS curves cover 365 days."
    } else {
      "The primary OS curves stop before 365 days."
    }
  )
)
```

```{r}
#| label: write-estimand-results
#| include: false

write_parquet(
  rmst_summary,
  file.path(results_dir, "rmst-summary.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
write_parquet(
  risk_summary,
  file.path(results_dir, "risk-summary.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
write_parquet(
  pooled_rmst,
  file.path(results_dir, "estimand-draws.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
write_parquet(
  pooled_curves,
  file.path(results_dir, "survival-curves.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
writeLines(
  as.yaml(follow_up_sufficiency),
  file.path(results_dir, "follow-up-sufficiency.yml")
)
```

## Posterior RMST difference

```{r}
#| label: build-os-rmst-posterior-plot
#| include: false

rmst_posterior_plot <- plot_posterior(
  pooled_rmst$rmst_diff,
  x_label = paste0(
    "Difference in ", horizon_days,
    "-day restricted mean survival time (ctDNA − usual care), days"
  )
)

save_figure(
  rmst_posterior_plot,
  file.path(figure_dir, "os-rmst-difference-posterior.png")
)
```
